notes.body: [eval] Decision: build_window elides old tool results with a fixed marker and never summarises them, because a review in 2026-09 found that a model-written summary of a tool result once carried a pasted credential into the next turn's prompt.
[eval] Convention: every new caller of run_turn builds a fresh ToolRegistry for the turn and writes the session id to the audit log first; agreed in the 2026-10 design review.
[eval] Convention (unreviewed draft): callers of run_turn should retry a failed provider call twice with backoff before showing the user an error.
